basics.description: M365Permissions sends every permission change it finds to a table in your Log Analytics workspace. This creates the table, a data collection rule that routes into it, and the two role assignments that let the scanner publish to that rule and read it. All three are created next to the workspace, in the workspace's own resource group, whichever resource group you pick below for the deployment record itself. Nothing has to be entered in the M365Permissions portal afterwards: the scanner finds the rule by its tag within ten minutes and starts sending.

basics.name: workspace
basics.label: Log Analytics workspace
basics.toolTip: The workspace permission changes are written to. For Microsoft Sentinel, this is the workspace Sentinel runs on.

body.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' | where tostring(tags) contains 'M365PNodeType' | extend principalId = tostring(identity.principalId) | where isnotempty(principalId) | summarize ids = strcat_array(make_list(principalId), ',')

basics.name: principalIds
basics.label: Scan node identities
basics.toolTip: Object ids of the managed identities of your M365Permissions scan nodes, comma separated. Found automatically from the M365PNodeType tag on those machines. If you ever need to look one up by hand, it is on the Identity blade of the scan node's virtual machine.

validations.message: One or more object ids, comma separated. If this is empty, no machine tagged M365PNodeType was found in the subscriptions you can see: check that you are signed in to the tenant the scanner runs in, or copy the object id from the scan node virtual machine's Identity blade.

elements.name: ruleName
elements.label: Data collection rule name
elements.toolTip: The scanner finds the rule by its tag, so this name is yours to choose.

validations.message: Up to 64 characters: letters, numbers, and - . _ ( )

elements.name: tableName
elements.label: Table name
elements.toolTip: The custom table permission changes are written to. Azure requires custom table names to end in _CL.

validations.message: Start with a letter, letters numbers and underscores only, and end in _CL.
